cc:Work.dc:title: How the leading teams reached the cutoff
cc:Work.dc:description: Eight tournament teams selected by their cutoff Elo rating, not by tournament results. Each line shows post-match-day ratings. 1500 initialization; simultaneous-day updates; constant K and home advantage selected on 2022–23 validation.
